name: Stage 49: Holmsjön to Bälinge kyrka
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 49, Holmsjön to Bälinge kyrka.
utilities: Holmsjön has no listed parking at the stage start and no close direct transit. Naturkartan/OSM place a shelter and dry toilet at the Holmsjön/Masugnsjön shelter cluster just west of the start, useful as start-side or stage-48 arrival context.
Tystberga is the practical service hub: Coop, restaurants, bus stops, parking, recycling-point context, and nearby paid lodging. Shop and food access are opening-hour or app/BankID dependent.
Bälinge kyrka has user-reported outdoor taps and toilet, nearby road/bus access at Bällinge vägskäl, and parking context at the church/end area. Treat the taps/toilet as likely but comment-sourced.
waterSources: No reliable public drinking-water source was found at Holmsjön or mid-stage before Tystberga. Carry water from stage 48/Svärta or treat natural water.

Coop/restaurants in Tystberga can provide practical resupply when open, but they are commercial/customer services. The Coop hybrid 24-hour model depends on phone, app/Scan & Pay, Mobile BankID, and current access rules.
Outside Bälinge kyrka, a 2024 official-page user comment reports water taps and a toilet. Treat as high-value but still verify season/access locally.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 11 km; Naturkartan measures 10.8 km/10,853 m, current OSM relation 7449352 measures about 10.863 km, and the local drawn route is about 10.815 km with endpoints close to official coordinates.

OSM relation 7449352 is a clean single-component through-line. It snaps exactly to Stage 48 at 58.829213,17.165855 and Stage 50 at 58.843621,17.295508, while the official/local endpoint clusters are nearby aliases: Holmsjön differs by about 5-22 m and Bälinge by about 21-59 m depending on source.

Easy main-route stage from Holmsjön/stage 48 to Bälinge kyrka/stage 50, mostly open landscape, private/minor roads, forest road, short forest sections, Tystberga village, school/sports-area paths, and church approach road. Current OSM geometry is road-heavy rather than deep-forest trail.
Official notes warn that cattle can occur in summer. Close gates, keep dogs controlled, and do not cross private yards or cultivated land outside the marked route.

Team Vildmark, Nya Stigar, and a 2025 hiker blog all describe extensive road/gravel-road walking, E4 noise around Sättra/Holmsjön, open agricultural walking, and easy terrain. The stage is fast and logistically useful because Tystberga has resupply and accommodation, but it is not a wilderness-service stage.
A 2025 hiker report says some markings needed repainting or replacement and a few posts/signs were lying down or hidden. Treat as a maintenance-watch note, not a formal closure.

No current official fault reports were shown on the official stage page during this research pass. No shelter, fireplace, or campsite was verified on the forward stage 49 line beyond the Holmsjön shelter cluster at/behind the start.

Ostlänken Sillekrog-Sjösa planning affects the Sättra-Holmsjön corridor and future rail construction is expected to require route attention/rerouting. No current Sörmlandsleden stage-49 reroute notice was found on 2026-04-27.

facilities.name: Holmsjön stage junction
facilities.description: Official stage 49 start and stage 48 end at Holmsjön's northwest tip. No parking is listed at this start.

facilities.name: Holmsjön lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water only; not a verified potable source. Treat/filter/boil if used.

facilities.name: Holmsjön access caveat
facilities.description: Official and Naturkartan notes say no parking at the stage start. No close direct bus/train stop was verified; arrange pickup carefully or use Tystberga/Borrvinds-area transit with extra walking.

facilities.name: Holmsjön/Masugnsjön shelter cluster
facilities.description: Naturkartan confirms shelter and dry toilet at Holmsjön, and OSM places the shelter cluster just west of the official stage-49 start. Useful at the start or when arriving from stage 48; not a mid-stage forward facility.

facilities.name: Holmsjön/Masugnsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the Holmsjön shelter cluster per Naturkartan/OSM context. Exact condition should be field-checked.

facilities.name: Holmsjön shelter fireplace caveat
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance normally expects a fireplace/grill by shelters, but no supplied firewood or bins. Use only if current fire rules allow and pack out waste.

facilities.name: Sättra / E4 noise and road-walk
facilities.description: Multiple hiker reports describe road-heavy walking and noticeable E4 traffic noise around Sättra/Holmsjön before Tystberga. Expect an easy but exposed logistics section.

facilities.name: Railway crossing before Tystberga
facilities.description: Route crosses the railway west of Tystberga. Use signed crossing controls and do not shortcut along the railway.

facilities.name: Tystberga trafikplats bus access
facilities.description: Regional bus access near E4 about 2 km from Tystberga center per official user comment. Useful bailout/onward context but not directly on the trail.

facilities.name: Tystberga village services
facilities.description: Stage passes through Tystberga, which official text lists as having grocery, food/fika, and buses. Verify opening hours and ticketing.

facilities.name: Coop Tystberga
facilities.description: Supermarket/resupply in Tystberga. Official and Coop sources describe hybrid 24-hour access with mobile phone, Scan & Pay, and BankID, while staffed hours can differ. Verify current access before relying on after-hours entry.

facilities.name: Tystberga recycling point by Coop
facilities.description: Mapped 24/7 recycling point by Coop. Use only for appropriate sorted packaging; pack out ordinary trail rubbish if bins are unavailable or full.

facilities.name: Tystberga bus stop
facilities.description: Central Tystberga Sörmlandstrafiken stop near grocery/food services. Current regional context includes Tystberga links toward Nyköping, Vagnhärad/Trosa, and Gnesta corridors; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Tystberga övre bus stop
facilities.description: Additional Tystberga bus-stop context north of the center, mapped in OSM and shown in line-510 listings. Useful for route planning only after checking current departures.

facilities.name: Röda Lyktan Tystberga
facilities.description: Restaurant/service option in Tystberga. Commercial opening hours apply.

facilities.name: Amigo Tystberga
facilities.description: Pizzeria/restaurant near the route in Tystberga. Commercial opening hours apply.

facilities.name: Tystberga Logi / Solbuska
facilities.description: Paid B&B/stuga lodging listed by Sörmlandsleden for stage 49 and locally described as near the route; local tourism material says open year-round. Book ahead.

facilities.name: Tystberga skola bus stop
facilities.description: Bus access by the school/sports-area route section. Verify live departures.

facilities.name: Nynäs IK klubbstuga rest
facilities.description: Official stage-steward tip says chairs and tables are available year-round at the clubhouse/lighted-track area. Clubhouse toilet/kitchen/shower/sauna appear to be member/rental facilities, not guaranteed public services.

facilities.name: Tystberga signed giant's kettle
facilities.description: Official text says a giant's kettle is signposted at the clubhouse/lighted-track area. Approximate pin until field-verified.

facilities.name: Stage 49 marking maintenance watch
facilities.description: A 2025 hiker report described worn paint, arrows needing replacement, and a few posts/signs lying down or hidden. Carry a map/GPS even though no official closure was found.

facilities.name: Tystberga road crossing
facilities.description: Uncontrolled pedestrian/cycle crossing context through Tystberga. Use normal traffic care through the village.

facilities.name: Road D 775 crossing
facilities.description: Approximate crossing/following point on road D 775 east of Tystberga before the pasture/church approach. Watch traffic.

facilities.name: Stage 49 cattle/gate warning
facilities.description: Official notes say cattle can occur in summer and the late stage passes pasture before Bälinge kyrka. Keep dogs controlled and close gates.

facilities.name: Bällinge vägskäl bus stop
facilities.description: Closest researched bus stop near the Bälinge kyrka endpoint, roughly 250-300 m away. Verify live departures.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka stage junction
facilities.description: Stage 49 end and stage 50 start at Bälinge kyrka, matching the local drawn endpoint. Official Stage 50 start is nearby at 58.843550,17.295850 and OSM shared snap is 58.843621,17.295508; treat all as one endpoint cluster.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka
facilities.description: Church with 1100s/medieval roots, described by the parish as one of Södermanland's most interesting churches. Respect churchyard rules.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka water taps
facilities.description: Official page user comment from 2024 reports water taps outside Bälinge kyrka. Useful but comment-sourced; verify season and access locally or with the parish before relying on it.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka toilet
facilities.description: Official page user comment from 2024 reports a toilet outside Bälinge kyrka. Useful but comment-sourced; verify opening/season before relying on it.

facilities.name: Bälinge kyrka parking
facilities.description: Naturkartan states there is parking at the end of stage 49. Verify local signs and church-event restrictions.

facilities.name: Bälinge churchyard dog rule
facilities.description: Nyköping local rules do not allow dogs on burial grounds. Keep dogs outside the churchyard/cemetery unless local signage explicitly allows otherwise.

facilities.name: Bälinge churchyard conduct
facilities.description: Treat the churchyard as a cemetery: no camping, no littering, avoid graves/plantings, use marked paths, and follow church-event/parking signage.

facilities.name: Oppeby Rooms off-route lodging
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden lodging list includes Oppeby Rooms for stages 49/50; directions place it about 700 m from the Bälinge approach. Treat as nearby off-route booked lodging, not an on-route facility.

facilities.name: D 778 church approach road
facilities.description: Final approach to Bälinge kyrka uses local/landsväg road context before the church. Watch traffic and keep to the marked route.

facilities.name: Tystberga/Bälinge public-place camping rule
facilities.description: Nyköping local public-place rules allow camping only at Strandstuguviken unless police permit is granted for an event. Do not pitch tents in Tystberga public areas, school/sports areas, roadsides, parking areas, or the churchyard.

facilities.name: Sättra road barrier access caveat
facilities.description: A 2025 hiker report noted a road barrier just beyond Sättra. Do not plan car pickup/dropoff on private or gated roads in the Sättra-Holmsjön corridor without checking access.

facilities.name: Ostlänken Sättra-Holmsjön watch
facilities.description: Trafikverket Ostlänken planning affects the Sättra-Holmsjön corridor and future rail construction may require route changes. No current official stage-49 reroute was found on 2026-04-27.

facilities.name: Stage 49 fire-risk check
facilities.description: No fireplace was verified on the core stage 49 line. Use only established fireplaces elsewhere and check current fire-ban status.
